task: pick up the black bowl between the plate and the ramekin and place it on the plate
public_data_description: public LIBERO demonstrations selected and preprocessed into an experimental split
image_preprocessing: existing native HF image processor on unchanged 256px source; no augmentation; same as connection test
action_normalization: fixed original train20 q01/q99; same calibration as prior experiment; no validation used
loss: teacher-forced cross entropy on seven action tokens plus EOS; prompt ignored
normalized_action_l1: decoded argmax action versus continuous normalized demonstration action; teacher-forced
checkpoint_selection: lowest full validation loss among trained checkpoints; baseline excluded
evaluation_initial_state_disjointness: not established; data split is at demonstration level
validation_every: each completed additional epoch; no optimizer on validation
evaluation_checkpoint_policy: every epoch6-10 and final epoch10, no early stopping
simulator_preprocessing: epochs5-10: upright 256px RGB directly into native HF processor
concurrent_work: one rollout evaluator may overlap training; wall time not an isolated speed benchmark
validation_statistics: fixed original training20 calibration, same as epoch5 checkpoint
learning_changes_only: five more passes; same data, LR, optimizer state, LoRA, normalization and training image processing
